intro: Amore Tossico examines proximity without lineage.

Off-white cotton, intentionally stained and structurally stressed, defines the surface language of the capsule. Irregular puffed sleeves alter proportion while arms remain consistently covered, limiting exposure and gesture.
end: The garments operate as uniform fragments assembled into a non-biological family.
Each piece exists as a singular 1/1 archive unit.

intro: Street Study. Romantic punk in the urban land.

It refers in particular to a series of colors, clothes and shapes typical of the 80s, with makeup referring to some cult films of those years. Specifically to romantic punk and new wave, all of which are revisited by Infimalega.
end: Each piece exists as a singular 1/1 archive unit.

intro: Insecto stages a small circus formation in progressive decay.

Vertical red striping establishes a regimental rhythm. Polka dot surfaces and exaggerated volumes reference ceremonial costume without preserving its function. Cosmetic intensity disrupts theatrical balance.
end: The capsule studies spectacle as structural corrosion.
Each garment is produced as an individual archive piece, fixed between display and deterioration.
